note: Town Board resolutions that take a personnel action by payroll file number, with the person the Town's payroll roster (company code GFZ) gives that number to. The match is by number on a roster that runs through file number 001308; a number above that has no name here. A resolution is an action, not a finding.

actions.title: POLICE DISCIPLINARY CHARGES
actions.quote: WHEREAS, Chief of Police Edward J. Frost has filed disciplinary charges against employee #GFZ000347

review.basis: The site owner asked on October 21, 2026 that employees named only by file number in disciplinary, termination and separation resolutions be identified. The number is on the roster once. The payroll lists this person as a Police Officer in Squad 1 through 2025, which fits charges filed by the Chief of Police. The quote is the resolution's first clause and carries no redactable item. Re-reviewed in three months because the charges are pending and a determination may follow.
